page.overview:
What is Mount Noton?

Mount Noton is a mountain in the far northern kingdom of Lomar in the Dreamlands. Between this mountain and Mount Kadiphonek is the Plateau of Sarkis, the site of the city of Olathoë.

From behind Mount Noton is a narrow pass that leads to Olathoë and is guarded by the Watchtower of Thapnen. (: "Polaris") Category:Regions/Territories Category:Locations Originating From Lovecraft Circle Works Category:Extra-Dimensional Locations
